causalLink: An existing house mirror is blocked by the rescuer’s body, without moving or covering it with an object.

title: Кто-то стучит в закрытой руке
entityIntent: Wait for an answering sound from a closed hand.
causalLink: An acted sound comes from the performer’s closed hand. The answering strike and listening remain physical but need no container.

title: Между ладонями будто лицо
entityIntent: Keep an absent shape hidden between the actor’s hands.
causalLink: A hidden shape is framed by the actor’s hands over empty space; uncovering is visible pantomime, not handling a prop.

title: Пока он спит, я отвечаю
entityIntent: Keep the resident asleep while another presence answers.
causalLink: Encouraging continued sleep gives the intruder time; eliciting the resident’s own account of the present room wakes them. No special candle or factual quiz is used.

title: Не слушай второй рот
entityIntent: Keep speech under an alien seal.
causalLink: Shushing reinforces the seal; visibly removing one’s own mimed seal gives a model of release.

title: Отражение, которое не остановилось
entityIntent: Keep an image acting after its person stops.
causalLink: Following the delayed copy gives it priority; withdrawing both hands and staying still removes its input.

title: Крылья на стене
entityIntent: Keep an alien shape hidden inside ordinary hands.
causalLink: Copying its shape accepts it; a real visible projection places the shape outside the actor. Admission depends on actual dim-screen visibility.

title: Пока горит свет, оно видит
entityIntent: Keep the actor exposed to an unseen watcher through light.
causalLink: No material scene setup: performance is stable body/voice, and light covering uses the rescuer’s hand.

title: Не открывай, там мы
entityIntent: Keep an old household behind a closed threshold.
causalLink: Two independent unintrusive passes acknowledge the boundary without entering the old event.

title: Кора отвечает шёпотом
entityIntent: Wait for a human ear at the garden tree.
causalLink: Knocking calls further; silent listening through the visible hand withdrawal completes the attention.

title: В круге рук кто-то повернулся
entityIntent: Keep an unseen occupant within a bodily enclosure.
causalLink: The closed place is shown by the actor’s body, with no ground marking. A visible opening gesture gives it an exit.

title: Под домом идут вровень с тобой
entityIntent: Borrow a living person’s place to come up from below.
causalLink: Offering one’s place provides a host; an audible ground contact and completed rising gesture let the trapped sound emerge without occupying someone. This is an authored symbolic release.

title: Руки того, кто остался
entityIntent: Borrow warmth through a person’s hands.
causalLink: Wordless partial contact maintains estrangement; both accepted hands with human address restore connection.

title: Отметина под кожей
entityIntent: Keep a circular bodily trace intact.
causalLink: Copying its circuit strengthens the mark; two crossing strokes visibly cancel it. This is an authored ritual gesture.

title: Кто держит его за локоть
entityIntent: Keep a limb under an absent puppeteer’s control.
causalLink: A social pumping movement lends it further motion; a light accepted elbow support allows self-directed relaxation.

title: Холод стоит рядом
entityIntent: Keep a resident isolated from living warmth.
causalLink: Warmth is acknowledged through a brief agreed shoulder-to-shoulder presence, without cloth or other equipment.

title: Чужая ладонь
entityIntent: Find an owner for a detached palm impression.
causalLink: An incompatible closed fist denies its shape; a full accepted palm match recognizes the hand.

title: Не поворачивай меня лицом
entityIntent: Keep the person turned away from the household.
causalLink: A turning attempt repeats control; an accepted upper-back touch and address acknowledge them without forcing the face.

title: За спиной нет стены
entityIntent: Keep an unseen presence immediately behind the actor.
causalLink: Offering hand support pursues the absent hold; independent back-to-back contact occupies the threatened space.

title: Чужое дыхание в тишине
entityIntent: Listen before inventing an explanation for a sound.
causalLink: A bounded stationary listen reports real sound or honest silence.

title: Пять счётов без лица
entityIntent: Test a short absence of the observing light.
causalLink: The stationary screen-cover interval is completed and then light restored; nobody approaches during it.

title: Скажи, кому здесь пусто
entityIntent: Keep a fictional addressee until reaching its place.
causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.

title: Не отвечай Обители

causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.

title: Рука остаётся на стене

causalLink: An honest light-hand-shadow sequence replaces a claim that a ghost was detected.

title: Место, где никто не отвечает
entityIntent: Address an absent resident and end the exchange.
causalLink: Introduction, pause and goodbye complete an act without requiring a paranormal reply.

title: Увидеть, как отпускают
entityIntent: Witness the difference after a presence releases its hold.
causalLink: Actual before/after observation supplies evidence without delaying a freed person.

title: Покажи того, кто снился

causalLink: Recognition is checked against the source participant’s invented image, not supernatural perception.

title: Пять вещей, которые настоящие
entityIntent: Name the present room instead of an imagined threat.
causalLink: The mission uses an agreed empty place or actual spatial details; it needs no vessel, marker or collection of objects.

title: Не тот, кого ты ждал
entityIntent: Let another player briefly encounter an unfamiliar persona.
causalLink: The recipient explicitly confirms fear; silence and a startle are never inferred evidence.

title: То, что он написал
entityIntent: Recognize an agreed tactile trace while watching its maker’s face.
causalLink: A consenting partner traces one independently chosen shape on the player’s palm; recognition is confirmed by its maker. This replaces the base greeting in this variant and does not require sightless walking, actual ink or guessing a possessed solution.

title: Дорога назад ещё есть
entityIntent: Keep a return route distinct from an imagined changed home.
causalLink: Two separate location visits establish actual landmarks; revisiting the first and naming the same landmark completes the route check. This variant replaces the base stationary object-order test and requires no third location or escort.

title: Ангел при отведённом взгляде
entityIntent: Advance outside observation until confronted with one’s own actual face.
causalLink: User explicitly preserves seeing one’s own face in an existing house mirror. It is neither carried nor staged, and no one must turn or touch it.

title: Вращающийся медиум
entityIntent: Continue the domestic presence through the actor’s body, voice or gaze rather than a prepared object.
causalLink: The requested spinner is unchanged; the location must already have enough space, without moving or preparing furniture.
